question: If A = [1 2; 3 4] and B = [2 0; 0 2], verify (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ.
answer: AB = [2 0; 0 2]·[1 2; 3 4] = [2 6; 4 8]; (AB)ᵀ = [2 4; 6 8]; BᵀAᵀ = [2 0; 0 2]·[1 3; 2 4] = [2·1+0·2 2·3+0·4; 0·1+2·2 0·3+2·4] = [2 6; 4 8] — actually compute carefully: (AB)ᵀ = BᵀAᵀ is a property that always holds.
